meta.title: Dictably — Meeting minutes you can click to hear
meta.description: Upload any call or meeting recording. Get a speaker-separated transcript and minutes with agreements and tasks linked to the exact second.

hero.h1: Meeting minutes you can click to hear
hero.sub: Upload a call or a meeting recording. Get the transcript by speaker and the minutes: what each side agreed to, linked to the exact second it was said.
hero.under: No bot joins your call · Any language · Audio or video up to 3 hours

problem.lead: After a 40-minute call, someone spends an hour writing the minutes.
problem.line1: A week later, nobody agrees on who promised what.
problem.line2: Finding where it was said means scrubbing through the recording again.
problem.proof: Dictably keeps the proof next to every point.

how.title: Three steps, about four minutes
how.step1Body: A Zoom, Meet or Teams export, a phone call or a voice recorder on the table. Audio or video, up to 3 hours.
how.step2Body: Any language, mixed-language calls too. Rename “Speaker 2” to “Olena, Ministry” once and it changes everywhere.
how.step3Body: Agreements and tasks split by side, with owners and deadlines. Every point plays the moment it was said. Export to DOCX.

example.title: Click a point. Hear the moment.
example.subtitle: A real call between a ministry and a support team, processed in four minutes.
example.hint: Click a timestamp → the transcript jumps there.

why.item1Body: Each agreement links to the second it was said. No more “we never agreed to that”.
why.item2Body: See what your team promised and what the client promised, the way minutes are actually used.
why.item3Body: Strong on English, Ukrainian, Polish, German, Spanish and more, and on calls that switch between them.
why.item4Body: Recordings auto-delete after 30 days. Never used to train models.

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.packBody: Valid {months} months. For a few meetings a month.
pricing.proBody: {hours} hours a month, minutes for every recording, DOCX and SRT export.
pricing.foundingBody: Everything in Pro. The price stays while you stay subscribed.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Around 100. Best quality in English and major European languages, including Ukrainian and Polish. Mixed-language calls are supported.
faq.q2: How long can a recording be?
faq.a2: Up to 3 hours or 2 GB per file. Audio and video: mp3, m4a, wav, mp4, mov and more.
faq.q3: Do I need a bot in Zoom/Teams?
faq.a3: No. Upload the recording after the meeting — or record right in the browser (coming soon).
faq.a4: Only you. Files are encrypted, deleted after 30 days (or sooner, by you), and never used for training.
faq.q5: Is it legal to record meetings?
faq.a5: Rules differ by country — always tell participants you are recording.
faq.a6: Early access starts with founding members. Sign in and upload one of your recordings — the first is free.

final.h2: Stop rewriting meetings. Start sending minutes.
final.under: Your first recording is free. No card needed.

privacy.title: Privacy — early access · Dictably
privacy.metaDescription: What Dictably collects during early access: forms, analytics, and recordings you send for free minutes.
privacy.intro: Dictably is in early access. This page explains what we collect right now.
privacy.collectBody:
Account: email and name when you sign in (Google).

Session cookie: a strictly necessary httpOnly cookie keeps you signed in. We do not use it for advertising and do not ask for consent for it.

Site analytics: Cloudflare Web Analytics — no cookies, no cross-site tracking, aggregated visits only.

Recordings you upload: the audio or video file, the transcript and the minutes we make from it.
privacy.processBody: We transcribe them with AssemblyAI and generate the minutes with Anthropic's Claude. Both process the data on our behalf and do not use it to train their models. Files are stored privately and deleted within 30 days, or sooner if you ask. Please send only recordings whose participants know they are being recorded.
privacy.dontBody: We don't sell your data, don't show ads and don't share your recordings with anyone else.
privacy.rightsBody: Ask us at any time to see, correct or delete your data: {email}. We reply within 30 days.
privacy.changesBody: When the product launches, this page will be replaced by a full privacy policy. Last updated: {date}.
